title: netSoldier Detection Event
description: Canonical detection event produced by the detection-engine. Version 1.0.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Bumped on breaking changes.

domain.description: Queried domain or domain(→IP) that matched.

matched_ioc.description: The IoC value that matched (domain, IP, hash).

ioc_type.description: Type of the matched indicator. 'tlsfp' is the TLS client fingerprint (JA4-format).

client_ip.description: IP address of the client that triggered the detection.

client_mac.description: MAC address of the client device (if known).

client_name.description: Hostname or friendly name of the client device.

source.description: IoC feed source (local, threatfox, feodo, spamhaus, misp, etc.).

threat.description: Malware family or threat campaign name.

mitre_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (e.g. T1071, T1071.004).

query_type.description: DNS query type (A, AAAA, CNAME, etc.).

tags.description: Arbitrary tags from the IoC source.

signals.description: Composite-confidence (step 116): contributing signal classes (ioc, ids-signature, beacon, volumetric, tls). Additive, optional.

signal_count.description: Composite-confidence (step 116): number of distinct corroborating signal classes. Additive, optional.
